rules.title: Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate tenancies without just cause and must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions. At-fault reasons include nonpayment, uncured violations, nuisance, illegal use, and refusing access; no-fault reasons include owner or family move-in, demolition, and government orders.

requires.name: tenancy_duration
requires.text: tenant has lived in the same unit for at least six months or original lease expired, whichever comes first

exempt_if.name: special_housing
exempt_if.text: transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless facilities or treatment centers, some HACLA or government-owned properties

exempt_if.name: subject_to_rso
exempt_if.text: units regulated by the City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance

coverage.summary: Covers most residential properties in Los Angeles not regulated by the RSO, after six months of tenancy or lease expiration.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exceptions include transient hotels, care facilities, fraternity houses, owner's roommate, some cooperatives, some nonprofit facilities, some government-owned property, and RSO units.

rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (AB 1482)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to 5% plus the regional change in cost of living, or 10%, whichever is lower.
rules.key_value: 5% plus CPI change, max 10%; 8.9% for 1 Aug 2024 to 31 Jul 2025

exempt_if.text: Units that were constructed within the last 15 years (rolling basis)

exempt_if.name: deed_restricted_affordable
exempt_if.text: Units restricted by a deed, regulatory restrictions, or other recorded document limiting affordability to low or moderate-income households

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: second unit occupied by an owner for the entire period of the tenancy

exempt_if.name: owner_type_and_notice
exempt_if.text: not owned by a real estate trust, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, and landlord gave written notice

coverage.summary: Applies to buildings older than 15 years.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts buildings under 15 years old, deed-restricted units, certain dormitories, owner-occupied two-unit properties, and qualifying single-family homes and condos.

rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region in which the property is located, or 10% whichever is lower
